import sys

import zstandard as zstd, io
# build a small frame and test bit 4 (unused) handling
cctx = zstd.ZstdCompressor(write_checksum=True)
data = cctx.compress(b'hello world')
print(data.hex())
mut = bytearray(data)
mut[4] |= 0x10  # unused bit
try:
    out = zstd.ZstdDecompressor().decompress(bytes(mut))
    print('unused bit OK', out)
except Exception as e:
    print('unused bit rejected:', e)
mut2 = bytearray(data)
mut2[4] |= 0x08  # reserved bit
try:
    out = zstd.ZstdDecompressor().decompress(bytes(mut2))
    print('reserved bit OK', out)
except Exception as e:
    print('reserved bit rejected:', e)
# stream_reader read_across_frames
frames = cctx.compress(b'aaa')+cctx.compress(b'bbb')
r = zstd.ZstdDecompressor().stream_reader(io.BytesIO(frames), read_across_frames=True)
print('across:', r.read())
